item.title: Scene cleared after I-65 wreck causes traffic standstill
item.description: Video above: Traffic standstill on I-65 southbound after wreck MOBILE, Ala. (WKRG) — Interstate 65 southbound traffic crawled Friday morning following a crash involving a semi-truck. The incident happened around 7:45 a.m. today on I-65, just past Highway 45, in Mobile.
